# Company: Smith Ribbon / Xiamen Smith Ribbon & Bow Co., Ltd. (厦门思蜜丝织带)
# Brand name: smithribbon.com

# Certifications: OEKO-TEX, BSCI, ISO 9001, SEDEX, SMETA, FSC

## About
> Smith Ribbon is a China-based OEM/ODM ribbon & bow manufacturer for the global gift packaging, festive decoration, hair accessory, and apparel trim industries. Direct factory pricing, low MOQ (500-1,000m), and fast sampling.

## Key Product Lines
- Satin / organza / grosgrain / velvet ribbon
- Christmas & holiday ribbon
- Floral wrap ribbon
- Pre-tied bows (gift / hair / cake)
- Custom printed ribbon (logo, pattern, hot stamp)
- Polypropylene, RPET, bamboo fiber ribbon
- Decorative bows for packaging
